# WorkRamp

> WorkRamp is an AI-first learning management system (LMS) designed to power employee training, customer education, and partner enablement at scale.

WorkRamp provides two main product lines: Employee Learning Cloud for internal L&D and sales enablement, and Customer Learning Cloud for partner and customer education. The platform leverages generative AI to streamline course creation, personalized learning paths, and onboarding workflows.

## Key Topics

- AI-first LMS
- Employee Learning Cloud
- Customer Learning Cloud
